zh: 有一个明确、可用实验支撑的核心结论
en: A central claim is supported by strong experiments

zh: 用左右双栏分别解释方法机制与核心收益
把视觉冲击力和明确的实验设置、数值证据放在一起
en: Use two panels for the mechanism and the central benefit
Pair compelling visual evidence with explicit numeric comparisons and experimental conditions

zh: 异构 GPU 的训练投入不能被误读为严格控制硬件后的纯速度比较
不可把项目主页的首屏视觉误称为论文 Figure 1
en: Cross-hardware training costs are not a controlled same-hardware speed benchmark
The website hero and the paper's Figure 1 are distinct assets

alt.en: SuperMimic paper Figure 1: imagined humanoid world-model rollout and 128 L40/168h versus 1 H100/3h compute comparison; not the decorative GPU-wall graphic.

label.zh: 论文原始 Figure 1 · 带出处

insight.zh: 将可视化的 world-model motion rollout 与可量化的训练投入并列，让“方法机制”与“价值主张”同时进入视野。
insight.en: Juxtapose a visible world-model motion rollout with quantitative compute context, connecting mechanism and claimed value.

zh: 左边以不同时间的人形姿态轨迹示意动态过程，而不是多个不同机器人。
右边显示 1 H100、3 小时与 SONIC 128 L40、7 天的官方训练配置对照。
硬件型号和训练口径与对比结论必须始终同屏标注。
en: Depict time-separated motion poses rather than multiple distinct robots.
Show the officially reported 1 H100/3 h and SONIC 128 L40/7 day settings.
Retain device models and measurement boundaries alongside any claim.

zh: 把机制与核心实验价值各压缩成一个面板。
用符合数据的轨迹、截图或图表显示方法，并标注时间关系。
仅在实验方法可核对时展示资源对照，不凭异构 GPU 计算绝对效率倍数。
en: Give mechanism and core measured value one panel each.
Use evidence-faithful motion imagery and clear time labels.
Only compare compute figures with documented conditions; avoid hardware-normalized claims without data.

zh: 不同 GPU 型号下的耗时与 GPU-hours 不等于严格等价硬件的消融。
当前主图为论文 Figure 1 的真实缩略预览，细节以原始论文或官方素材为准。
en: Cross-GPU wall clock and GPU-hours are not controlled same-hardware ablations.
The primary preview is a reduced-size excerpt of the actual paper Figure 1; verify detail in the official source.
